Hit .198 (22-for-111) with four doubles, five home runs and 17 RBI in 54 games with the Phillies...Appeared at left field (27 games), second base (11 games), first base (nine games), pitcher (two games) and third base (one game)...Began the season on the 10-day Injured List (left oblique strain) and was activated on 4/22...Made scoreless relief appearances on the mound on 5/31 vs. MIL and 6/5 at TOR...Played in 25 games with Triple-A Lehigh Valley, batting .250 (26-for-104) with five doubles, one triple, three home runs and four steals. 2024 Spent majority of the season with Lehigh Valley (AAA) but appeared in a career-high 41 games for the Phillies over two stints with the club...Completed the 10th cycle in Phillies history (ninth player, first rookie) on 8/15 vs WSH – was the sixth-fewest games (24) needed to a cycle in ML history...Defensively, appeared at LF (21 G, 14 GS), third base (5 G, 4 GS), second base (4 G, 2 GS), RF (4 G, 1 GS), first base (3 G) and CF (1 G)...Made his season debut on 6/9 vs NYM at London Stadium after being recalled from Lehigh Valley on 6/3...Slashed .313/.366/.563 with a .929 OPS in 20 starts from 7/12-end of season...His 4 hits on 8/15 vs WSH were a career high and in the fourth frame, tallied two hits in a single inning for the first time in his career...Was on the Paternity List, 8/26-27...Pitched in the Majors for the first time in his career on 8/28 vs HOU (1.0 IP, 0 R)...Named International League Player of the Week after slashing .417/.500/.917 with 4 HR and a 1.417 OPS in six games for the IronPigs from 6/25-30...Slashed .240/.340/.487 in 71 games for the IronPigs and in 20 G (93 PA) after being optioned on 6/15, had 10 HR, 20 RBI and a 1.186 OPS...Defensively for Lehigh Valley, made 29 starts at SS, 24 starts at third base, 13 starts in LF, two starts at second base and one start in RF...Made his first career postseason appearance; started in LF in Game 4 of the NLDS vs NYM on 10/9. 2023 Spent the majority of the season with Lehigh Valley (AAA), slashing .259/.363/.515 with an .878 OPS, 53 XBH (19 2B, 3 3B, 31 HR) and 86 RBI in 125 games...Named an MilB.com Organization All-Star...Ranked third in the International League in HR, sixth in runs scored (90), T-7th in RBI & SB (32), T-8th in XBH and 10th in SLG...His 31 HR, 90 runs scored and 86 RBI led all Phillies Minor Leaguers...Became the first player in Lehigh Valley history with 30+ HR and 30+ SB in a season...Had his contract selected from Lehigh Valley on 8/6 and played eight games over three stints with the Phillies...Made his ML debut on 8/9 vs WSH and became the fifth Phillie to homer in his first career plate appearance (last, Marlon Anderson on 9/8/98 vs NYM)...Became the ninth Major Leaguer and third Phillie since 1901 with a HR and two walks in his ML debut (last, Ricky Jordan on 7/17/88)...Was the first Phillie since Jimmy Rollins (9/17/00) to reach base safely at least three times in his ML debut...Was the first Phillie in the modern era (since 1901) with a HR and a SB in his ML debut and the 13th Phillie overall with a SB in his first career game...His six walks were the most by a Phillie in his first five career games in the modern era. 2022 Spent his second full season with Nashville (AAA) in MIL’s system...Hit two HR on 4/28 at St. Paul...Went 3-for-5 with two doubles, four RBI and a walk on 5/15 at Jacksonville. 2021 Played for Nashville...Had 28 extra-base hits (11 2B, 3B, 16 HR) and a career-best .548 SLG...Named MIL’s Co-Minor League Player of the Month for June (24 G, .272 AVG, 5 HR)...Missed the final month of the season after having thoracic outlet surgery on his right shoulder...Following the season, played for Salt River in the Arizona Fall League. 2020 Did not play. 2019 Played in a career-high 127 games for Biloxi (AA)…Named a Southern League All-Star and an MiLB.com Organization All-Star...Finished T-2nd in the SL in runs (70), 4th in HR (19) and T-4th in games...Named SL Player of the Week, 4/22-28...Named MIL’s Minor League Player of the Month and SL Player of the Month for April (.295 AVG, 6 HR, 18 RBI). 2018 Spent most of the season with Carolina (A), but also appeared in 12 games for Biloxi...Selected as the Carolina League Player of the Week, 4/23-29...Named MIL’s Minor League Player of the Month and CL Player of the Month in July (.436 AVG, 5 HR, 23 RBI)...Following the season, played for Peoria in the Arizona Fall League and hit .375 with 2 HR and 7 RBI in 13 games. 2017 Split the season between Carolina and Wisconsin (A). 2016 Began pro career with Helena (R)...Finished 4th in the Pioneer League in triples (7)...Had 23 walks to 33 strikeouts and posted a .390 OBP.
